pick.headline: Albanians storm foreign embassies in Tirana seeking asylum
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of July 3, 1990, carried a Cologne Deutschlandfunk report that 84 Albanians had taken refuge in the West German embassy in Tirana under police gunfire, some breaking through the gate with a truck, and that other Western embassies had been overrun.

alternates.headline: Gromyko made Soviet head of state; Shevardnadze takes the Foreign Ministry
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of July 2, 1985, opened its national affairs section with the Supreme Soviet session: Gromyko elected president on Gorbachev's nomination, Shevardnadze named foreign minister, and a TASS biographical sketch of Shevardnadze.
